meta.title: Image Color Replacer - Change Colors in Images Online
meta.subtitle: Swap specific colors in your photos or logos easily online.
meta.desc: Replace specific colors in your images online. Change red to blue, background colors, or object colors easily with our free tool.

input.title: Replace Color in Image
input.desc: Upload an image, pick a color to replace, and choose a new color.

content.title: Online Image Color Replacer
content.p1: Easily change colors in logos, photos, and graphics without Photoshop. Our Image Color Replacer allows you to select any color in your image and swap it with another.
content.p2: Adjust the tolerance level to replace shades and gradients effectively. This is perfect for visualizing new product colors or correcting color mistakes.

easy.title: Easy to Use
easy.desc: Just point and click to select the color you want to change.

tolerance.title: Smart Tolerance
tolerance.desc: Adjust fuzziness to catch similar shades and edges seamlessly.

preview.title: Instant Preview
preview.desc: See your changes immediately before downloading.

how_to.title: How to Replace Colors
list: Click on the image to select the 'From' color.
Choose your desired 'To' color from the picker.
Adjust the Tolerance slider until the replacement looks right.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: This tool replaces colors globally. If you have a red ball and a red shirt, both will change if they are the same shade.
faq.a2: Tolerance determines how exact the color match must be. Higher tolerance includes more similar shades.
